issues.detail: The Agents, hooks, Save/load and streaming sections give API names without runnable code, and the migration table refers to MIGRATION.md instead of showing the changes, so only the RAG and custom-component examples can be run as written.

scenarios.name: rag-pipeline-3x-chat-generator
scenarios.rationale: Response A matches the rubric: separate indexing and query pipelines, in-memory store, ChatPromptBuilder with a ChatMessage template list, OpenAIChatGenerator, question passed to both the embedder and prompt_builder, and the answer read via replies[0].text. Response B uses the legacy PromptBuilder and OpenAIGenerator, has no indexing pipeline with DocumentWriter, and prints replies[0] as a string rather than .text.

scenarios.name: migrate-2x-code-to-3x
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers every rubric item (OpenAIChatGenerator with .text, Pipeline with run_async, PromptBuilder with required_variables=None, and ExtractiveReader moved to transformers-haystack as TransformersExtractiveReader), while Response A declines to answer and supplies none of them.

scenarios.name: custom-component-save-load-yaml
scenarios.rationale: A covers all rubric points: the allowlist explanation, both allowed_modules and the env var fix, the unsafe=True warning, and the three Mock components. B never mentions the allowlist or the safe fixes, offers wrong diagnoses, and recommends patching OpenAI components instead of the Mock components.
